COMMODITY_ETF_PROXY.universe_source: convenience selection of the most liquid commodity ETFs (chosen by this task, NOT read from a repo file) - see caveats; measures the ETF wrapper only
caveats: Measures the ETF WRAPPER's spread only. It is NOT the futures contract's spread and does NOT include roll cost.
It answers 'what would commodity exposure via an ETF cost', not 'what does the futures momentum strategy pay'.
Do not let this number unblock the commodity momentum verdict.
Universe is a convenience selection by this task, not a repo file.
